#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

int main() {
    std::string s;
    std::cin >> s;
    int n = s.length();
    std::vector<int> boundaries;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
        if (i == n || s[i] != s[i - 1]) {
            boundaries.push_back(i);
        }
    }
    int count = 0;
    int start = 0;
    for (int end : boundaries) {
        if (((end - start) & 1) == 0) {
            ++count;
        }
        start = end;
    }
    std::cout << count;
    return 0;
}
